regions.today: Remaining breezy, mostly cloudy with any rain becoming patchier this afternoon. Some dry spells will develop, especially further to the south. However, there'll be further scattered outbreaks of light rain and drizzle lingering in places. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in moderate to fresh and gusty southwest winds, stronger for exposed coasts.
regions.tonight: Mostly cloudy for a time tonight, with scattered outbreaks of light rain and drizzle, along with some mist and hill fog. Becoming mainly dry overnight though, as a clearance extends southwards with just a few isolated showers following. Mild with temperatures not falling below 13 to 15 degrees in moderate to fresh and occasionally gusty southwest winds, stronger in exposed coastal parts.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Saturday, will be a breezy, mainly dry day, with some bright or sunny spells. There'll just be a few well scattered showers around, these mainly further north. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, in moderate, occasionally fresh and gusty southwest to west winds, moderating later.
regions.solar_uv: Low on Friday. Low, but moderate in sunny spells on Saturday.
